about: Brand-neutral catalogue of every module and core technique for a ghost client. Query this instead of re-reading the SKILL prose. Fields per module: name, category (combat/movement/world/player/render/hud/utility), summary, technique (how it works), hook (where it attaches, generically), anticheat_notes (why it reads as legitimate / what it avoids; 'cosmetic/client-side' = sends no packets, unflaggable), settings (notable tunables), and risk (anticheat visibility low/med/none). 'techniques' holds the shared engines (including movement_physics, targeting and the packet_engine); 'threat_model' maps the server anticheat detectors (Grim/NCP/Vulcan/Verus/Intave/Matrix) to the counter each technique relies on; 'patterns' holds reference-analysis patterns worth implementing.

primitives: triangular reactionMs (mid-biased, avg of two uniforms)
humanization.reaction_gate: arms a randomized delay on the rising edge of a stimulus; true only once it elapses, resets when the stimulus goes away — one fresh reaction per appearance

mouse_gcd.formula: f = sens*0.6 + 0.2; deg_per_count = f^3 * 1.2 (mirrors vanilla sensitivity math exactly)
rules: snap the wire rotation to the grid anchored on last-sent: base + round((target-base)/gcd)*gcd
if a step rounds to 0 but target >=1 count away, take sign(delta)*gcd so it never stalls
carry the sub-count remainder across ticks (a real mouse accumulates)
advance eased aim on real dt (sub-tick); snap only the value that leaves on a packet
snap the SERVER rotation only; snapping a per-frame camera step reads as a visible stair-step

eased_rotator: AR(1) hand drift driftYaw=driftYaw*0.92+jitter(0.04) (pitch 0.03), amplitude ~0.1deg so a held aim is never frozen
ease-out settle with a firm floor clamp(max(|dYaw|,|dPitch|)/12,0.34,1)

per-tick pace = logNormal(sigma=0.14, clamp 0.72..1.6): a right-skewed median-1 multiplier (exp(N(0,0.14))), NOT the old symmetric uniform x[0.85,1.15] band — human turn speeds are right-skewed and a flat band reads as too even
a hair of positional jitter while turning: +jitter(0.12) yaw / jitter(0.08) pitch above 1.5deg of remaining delta
overshoot min(|d|*0.12,6) over 25deg turns, decays x0.55/tick (zeroed under 0.4), ~500ms cooldown
GCD snap on the server path only (snap step to grid; if it rounds to 0 but |delta|>=gcd take sign(delta)*gcd so it never stalls)

reset() on disengage (active=false, overshoot/drift/ticks cleared) so the next engagement eases in fresh instead of continuing mid-swing; the aim CONTROLLER additionally resets reaction delay + ease-in + overshoot on a target switch

rotation_ownership.problem: last-writer-wins -> two placement modules flicker the rotation; one module's release cancels another's in-progress hold
rotation_ownership.solution: ControlClaim{owner, priority, lastRefresh}; aim(yaw,pitch,dist,token,correctMovement); a live owner (refreshed <~120ms) keeps it unless the newcomer is strictly higher priority; a stale claim is free to take; release(token) is a no-op unless token holds it; on release ease the server rotation back to the camera (no snap)
rotation_ownership.two_packet_paths: the move packet carries one rotation but a use-item/interact packet carries its OWN; feed the silent rotation into the use path for that one interaction (a useWithSilent flag) or throws/places fire where the camera points
movement_correction: Proper: re-pick WASD against the server yaw, snap to nearest of 8 dirs, sprint only when forward of it
Slow: keep real keys, kill sprint past 45deg off-facing

prediction_sim.recipe: AABB from start pos+vel; loop ticks applying real accel/drag; per-axis collision sweep (Shapes.collide Y then X then Z vs swept block shapes); read-only; cap the tick budget; act on where things WILL be — the resulting packet is legal so the server can't object
prediction_sim.fall: vy=(vy-0.08)*0.98, horizontal air drag 0.91 only on an uncollided axis, ~70 tick cap -> {lands,voided,landX,landZ,drop,water}; simulates the real arc so knockback/momentum throws are caught and the true landing column feeds placement
prediction_sim.mace_impact: a smash does most damage on the last airborne tick: hold the attack while falling, release only when stepping one fall move ahead collides; a >5 drop smashes immediately to avoid clipping the ground
prediction_sim.projectile: per-type constants (ender pearl: gravity 0.03, drag 0.99, throw 1.5); predict an enemy projectile's landing from its pos+vel, OR brute-force your launch pitch over a range, simulate each, keep the nearest-landing, add inherited horizontal velocity, throw only if miss < tolerance

baseline: reaction (triangular, new target) + shorter reacquire (target back from behind cover) delays
multi-octave sinusoidal shake applied as per-frame delta
upgrades: target-rate feed-forward ffRate=ffRate*0.6+(dWant/dt)*0.4, add clamp(ffRate*dt,+-6) so a strafing target is tracked not lagged (PD+I adds a leak-decayed integral + derivative; feed-forward is the highest-impact piece)
adaptive speed scale=clamp(|dYaw|/20,0.35,1.5), softer when on-target
per-target randomized gains x0.8-1.2 + per-tick lognormal speed with point-blank slowdown

clicks: fatigue+bursts: top of range ~1.5s then 0.15+0.75*e^(-(t-1.5)/12), recovery between fights
styles: Jitter/Butterfly/Drag all averaging to CPS
Click Assist amplifies real clicks only
stand down while an aura drives the attack
packets: one owner-aware PacketDelay service, rules claimed with a module token; PacketConflicts auto-disables a contending module
max held-age cap (Max Desync) so movement never desyncs far enough to flag
allowlist: delay only position packets; actions/container/keep-alive/chat/teleport-confirm go live; flush held ones first when a live packet follows
flush+pause on own attack, on taking knockback, on any server correction/teleport

movement_physics.about: Every movement module rides vanilla physics; reproduce the integration exactly (and per engine version) because a prediction anticheat runs the same replay. Per-tick order: apply input accel -> move with per-axis collision sweep (Y then X then Z, same as the prediction sims) -> apply drag/friction for next tick -> gravity.

constants.horizontal_friction: vx,vz *= friction next tick; friction = onGround ? blockSlipperiness*0.91 : 0.91. Default slipperiness 0.6 -> ground 0.546, air 0.91. Slipperiness: ice/packed-ice 0.98, blue-ice 0.989, slime 0.8
constants.acceleration: ground = moveSpeed * (0.21600002 / friction^3); air = flat ~0.02. moveSpeed = walk attribute base 0.1 * 1.3 while sprinting (sprint is a transient +30% attribute modifier, not a velocity hack)
constants.jump: vy = 0.42 (+0.1*(JumpBoost+1)); a sprint-jump adds a one-off horizontal 0.2 along facing yaw (the biggest legal ground-speed burst, the honest basis for Bhop)
constants.use_item_slowdown: while isUsingItem() and not riding, forward/strafe INPUT is scaled by 0.2 before acceleration; sneak scales input by 0.3 (input multipliers, not speed caps)

modules.step: add a transient STEP_HEIGHT attribute modifier (height-base, ADD_VALUE) while grounded, removed off-ground/on disable, never touching the base; survives prediction because the AC reads the attribute and simulates the taller step (a setPos teleport-up would diverge). Ground-gate it.
modules.speed_bhop: staged launch on the jump tick (take the legal 0.2 sprint-jump boost) then let friction decay carry momentum, re-launching each jump; keep peak horizontal <= what accel+friction can reach or a sustained over-speed flags survivalfly/Grim
modules.strafe_air_accel: rewrite air input toward the move vector each tick, respecting the 0.02 air-accel cap; never add velocity the input couldn't
modules.longjump: slipperiness-aware launch, but horizontal still decays by the block friction each tick and the impulse must be one a jump could legally produce
modules.noslow: a modifyInput redirect that skips ONLY the 0.2 use-item input scale, leaving sneak and all other modifiers. HIGH RISK on prediction ACs: Grim models the 0.2 slowdown, so full-speed-while-using diverges from its replay; survives only where the AC doesn't model use-item slowdown (older NCP). The textbook 'legit-looking but physically inconsistent' case
modules.keepsprint_omnisprint: re-assert isSprinting the tick an attack/KB clears it (setSprinting(true) when vanilla would still allow: forward held, food>6, not using item, not mid-crit). KeepSprint = genuine vanilla sprint, safe. OmniSprint (sprinting sideways/backward) is non-vanilla and trips sprint-direction checks
modules.velocity: scale deltaMovement after the server applies KB, with precision jitter so the result is never a clean fraction of the push (see modules.Velocity)

movement_physics.universal_rule: a prediction AC accepts any motion SOME legal input could produce and flags motion no input could, so survive it only by changing the inputs/attributes the AC also reads (sprint flag, step attribute, jump, input vector), never by writing an output position those inputs don't justify. Heuristic ACs flag raw magnitudes, so there you tune under the threshold

targeting.about: Combat modules share one TargetSetting so target policy is set once and obeyed everywhere (who to aim at, who to never touch).
targeting.target_setting: bundles entity TYPES (Players/Mobs/Animals, picked with popout tabs) with FILTERS (ignore invisible / naked / behind-walls / friends / teammates / bots) and an optional Max Distance. test(e) = not the local player AND matches: right type and enabled, within range, line-of-sight (clip eye->eye or eye->body-centre, cached per entity per game tick), and not filtered. Player-only filters (naked/friends/teammates/bots) fold away when Players isn't a selected type
targeting.friends: a case-insensitive name set persisted to friends.json; Friends.is(name) gates radar colours, name tags and the Ignore Friends filter; toggled with a chat command
targeting.teammate_detection: never attack your own team: isTeammate = same vanilla scoreboard team, OR same non-white name colour as you (team colour, else the first colour in the display name; -1 when white/none so two white names don't match). Uses the entity's own team/display-name colour, NOT getTeamColor() (ESP outline overrides that)
targeting.anti_bot_filter: the Ignore Bots filter reads AntiBotModule.isBot(e), a per-tick cached behaviour-score verdict (see modules.AntiBot), so aura/clicker/visuals all skip flagged fake players through the same gate
targeting.dev_hook: -Dnihil.dev.standsAsPlayers makes armor stands count as Players, to test player-only visuals/aim on a summoned dummy

packet_engine.about: One service holds packets on the client's own connection and releases them in order; backs BackTrack, FakeLag, Blink, KnockbackDelay and Velocity-delay. Incoming decided on the Netty thread, released on the main thread through vanilla's own dispatch; outgoing queued from any thread and re-sent from the main thread.
packet_engine.queues: three lock-free concurrent queues: 'incoming' (everything KnockbackDelay holds + whatever arrived behind it, one global line), 'entityHeld' (one target's movement, for BackTrack), 'outgoing'. Each record keeps {packet, releaseAt, queuedAt} (incoming also the PacketListener; outgoing the callback/flush flags) so order and timing survive the wait
packet_engine.rules: a rule is holdUntil(packet, now) -> 0 = let through, else the release timestamp. Two shared slots (outgoing, incoming/knockback) plus the per-entity BackTrack slot. Each slot is OWNER-AWARE: setRule(ownerModule, rule) records the owner; clearRule(owner) is a no-op unless that owner still holds it, so a disabling module can't rip out another's rule
packet_engine.conflict_resolution: PacketConflicts: before claiming a slot, if another ENABLED module holds it, switch that one off with a toast ('FakeLag turned off Blink - both use outgoing packet timing') instead of silently overwriting and leaving the loser enabled-but-dead
packet_engine.reentrancy: releasing a held packet must not recurse into the rule. Outgoing uses a ThreadLocal RESENDING set true while re-sending (the hook short-circuits for its own resends, cleared in finally). Incoming replays through an accessor onto vanilla's packet handler, guarded so a packet whose connection moved on (listener swapped, config phase, disconnected, !isAcceptingMessages) is dropped not force-fed
packet_engine.allowlist: delay ONLY movement/position packets; the rule returns 0 for everything else. Block/use carry a client sequence the server acks+predicts against (holding desyncs blocks/inventory); container clicks, keep-alives, chat, teleport-confirms go live (holding = timeout/brick). Protocol-critical inbound (disconnect, start-configuration) must never wait: force everything ahead of them to release now and queue them right behind. When a live packet follows held ones, flush the held ones first so order is preserved
packet_engine.ordering: releasing a globally-held (ALL) packet first releases any entityHeld packets queued before it, so the two incoming lines merge back into real arrival order and BackTrack's frozen target doesn't teleport relative to the world on release
packet_engine.flush_pause: instantly drain + stand down on your own attack packet (so a held position never costs the hit), on taking knockback (your real position jumped), and on any server position-correction/teleport (tracked as lastPositionCorrection on the network thread when a ClientboundPlayerPosition arrives). Modules also cap held-packet age (Max Desync) so movement never desyncs far enough for the prediction/timer detectors
packet_engine.hazards_avoided: holding keep-alive -> kick; holding block/use -> inventory/block desync + rejected actions; holding past a setback -> acting on a stale position (setback detector); speeding the clock instead of delaying -> timer flag; touching the integrated server's connection -> guard every entry on 'is this the client's own play-state game connection'

placement.shared_service: fill a target by clicking a sturdy neighbour's exposed face the way a right-click would, with reach + sturdy-full-face validation centralised; report the hit point back only on a successful place (a failed reach never turns the head); blocksNeeded() -> 0/1/2/-1; support() tries DOWN,NORTH,SOUTH,EAST,WEST and requires !canBeReplaced && isFaceSturdy (so a slab/fence/torch/carpet/air/water/fire is rejected before a packet is sent — the 'placing into air / on fire' bug); placeAt() fills the target or, failing that, the horizontal neighbour that has support (a diagonal step first)
placement.hit_vec_jitter: the clicked point is the neighbour-face centre offset by jitter(0.18) clamped to +-0.4 on the two in-plane axes only (never along the face normal), kept well inside the face so the block still places and stays in reach — so placements don't all land on the exact block-face centre, a dead giveaway. hitFor()/rotationTo() (used by Aim View and the planner's rotCost) use the un-jittered centre
placement.shared_planner: PlacementSearch generalises the greedy placer (now IMPLEMENTED, not just aspirational): frontier(targets) = the subset fillable this tick (replaceable AND BlockPlacer.hitFor != null), sorted by rotCost = |wrapDegrees(yaw-lookYaw)| + |pitch-lookPitch| so the caller places the cheapest-aim-movement ones first and the frontier re-expands next tick as fresh blocks create new supports. planTo(goal, maxSteps) = bounded best-first (A*) over the 6-neighbourhood to bridge to an unreachable goal: seed the open set with every position within maxSteps of the goal that's reachable-placeable now, treat each expanded cell as solid-once-placed, priority = path.size() + sqrt(distSqr(goal)) (cost=steps, heuristic=block distance, admissible), prune cells farther than maxSteps*maxSteps*4 or beyond 6-block eye reach; returns the placement order ending at goal, or empty. Surround consumes frontier(); Scaffold/Clutch/AutoAnchor can share it
scaffold_specifics: half-block-aware placeY: feet at .5 on a slab -> build from floor(y), else floor(y)-1
nearest-first ring of feet spots (next-tick landing, diagonal corner-fills, current column)
Expand re-anchor: reach the 8 neighbouring columns if the feet column can't be filled
Legit predictive edge-sneak on a randomized human hold; GodBridge/TellyBridge place under feet while walking/airborne, never above start-Y+Y-increase
clutch_specifics: scan from under the feet downward through reach, 3x3 ring + momentum/landing column nearest-first
look-down is cosmetic (block placed off the hit result, not the rotation)
released() guard (landed / no longer dangerous / timed out) so the view/silent rotation never sticks mid-air

damage_model.explosion: normalise distance by radius*2 (power6 crystal -> 12); impact=(1-d)*exposure; raw=((imp^2+imp)/2*7*q+1); reduce by armour+toughness, blast/generic protection (blast counts double), Resistance
damage_model.exposure: fire a small grid of rays from across the target hitbox back to the blast centre; fraction unobstructed = seen-percent (also used as placement efficiency)
damage_model.reachability: ALWAYS raytrace eye->face: the clip must land on the candidate block (or nothing between) or the server rejects the place; a legit place needs a full sturdy face, in reach, unobstructed — this is what stops 'place into wall / on fire'

techniques.item_score: shared comparator driven off the item's own attribute modifiers (robust across versions): armour = armour pts + toughness/2 (+protection); weapon = attack damage + per-enchant bonuses; tool = dig speed + efficiency/fortune. Feeds auto-armor best-per-slot + 2-set swap, auto-weapon, and a better-than-equipped loot gate
techniques.anti_bot: accumulating per-entity behaviour score summed from independent weak signals since first seen: sustained air-hover (>1s ~conclusive +10), not in tab list (+4), NPC/red name (+5); threshold ~8 so no single signal false-positives and a still-standing player never trips; expose ignoreForCombat / ignoreForVisuals
techniques.esp_render: true 3D world-space box ESP is now IMPLEMENTED (ESP 'World' mode) alongside the screen-projected modes. World mode (WorldMesh + WorldRenderTypes) builds camera-RELATIVE line + fill geometry on the CPU and submits it inside the level render pass via collector.submitCustomGeometry, so it depth-tests and occludes against terrain like real world geometry (no bobbing/FOV drift, no behind-camera flicker). Mechanics: (1) each box = 12 edge polylines + optional 6 filled faces at ~14% of the edge alpha; (2) lines are expanded to camera-facing ribbon QUADS on the CPU: side dir = normalize(tangent x eyeRay), half-width in world units = (halfPx+1px)*worldPerPx*depth so the on-screen width is depth-independent, with a 1px anti-aliased feather carried in UV0.x (signed px from the line centre) and the core half-width in a per-vertex LineWidth attribute; (3) near-plane clip at depth 0.1 along the forward vector: an edge with one endpoint behind the camera is TRIMMED to the near plane (lerp pos+colour), not dropped — this is the fix for the screen-projection flicker; (4) a VISIBLE/HIDDEN render-type pair partitions the screen by depth (reversed-Z: visible=GEQUAL, hidden=LESS), the hidden through-wall pass drawn first at ~0.28 alpha; both share a small depth bias so faces lying on a block don't z-fight. worldPerPx is derived from 2/(framebufferHeight*projMatrix.m11). The 2D fallback was also fixed: it now keeps only the in-front corners and shrinks the box to the visible part (min/max of non-behind corners) instead of returning the moment one corner crosses behind the camera. A shared world projector still captures the exact modelview (camera*bob*shake) and projection (dynamic FOV) for the screen-projected modes; chams draw targets through walls (depth off) and must be exempt from culling; a framebuffer edge-detect pass gives a clean silhouette outline

patterns.name: Shared A* placement planner (PlacementSearch)
patterns.summary: The shared greedy placer generalised into one planner, now implemented. frontier(targets) returns the subset placeable this tick (replaceable + a reachable sturdy face via hitFor), ordered cheapest-rotation-first (rotCost = |yaw delta|+|pitch delta| from your current look to the click face); the caller places one or a few per tick and the frontier re-expands next tick as new blocks create supports. planTo(goal,maxSteps) is a bounded best-first/A* over the 6-neighbourhood to bridge to an unreachable goal: seed with reachable-placeable cells near the goal, treat each expanded cell as solid-once-placed, priority = steps + block-distance heuristic (admissible), prune beyond reach/budget; returns the placement order. Surround consumes frontier(); Scaffold/Clutch/AutoAnchor can share the same solver with different goal tests. Turns 'which block next' into one planner.

patterns.name: Opportunistic backtrack rewind
patterns.summary: Hold a target's movement packets only while the delayed position sits FURTHER ALONG YOUR AIM RAY than the live one (and the ghost stays reachable + in front of the crosshair); flush the moment it isn't, you take knockback, or they stop backing off. Buys reach without piling on flaggable desync out of its window.

patterns.name: Legal hitbox expansion
patterns.summary: Widen a hitbox to aim more easily, but project the outgoing interaction vector back onto the REAL box edge so the attack packet the server receives still lands on the genuine hitbox — the expansion helps you, the server sees a legal hit.

patterns.name: Range-gated exploits
patterns.summary: Engage fakelag/timer/kb-delay only when an enemy is within N blocks and roughly ahead, via a shared nearest-enemy-within(range,angle) predicate, so you're never conspicuously desynced out of combat. Dynamic fakelag lags while closing then dumps the backlog at reach; Repel lags only while your velocity points at the target.

patterns.name: True 3D world-space ESP (ribbon lines in the level pass)
patterns.summary: Emit camera-relative line+fill geometry inside the level render pass so boxes depth-test and occlude like world geometry (survive bobbing/FOV). Lines are expanded on the CPU into camera-facing ribbon quads with depth-independent width (halfPx*worldPerPx*depth), a 1px edge-UV feather and a per-vertex LineWidth; edges crossing behind the camera are trimmed to a near plane (depth 0.1), not dropped, which kills the screen-projection flicker. Draw a visible pass (depth GEQUAL) and a faded hidden through-wall pass (depth LESS) with a shared depth bias; fills at ~14% alpha. Screen-projected corner lines remain the simpler 2D-overlay alternative (and were fixed to shrink to the in-front corners rather than vanish when one corner goes behind you). Pair with a framebuffer edge-detect outline for a clean silhouette.

patterns.name: Log-normal rotation/timing realism
patterns.summary: Sample per-tick turn speeds and click intervals from a right-skewed log-normal exp(N(0,sigma)) (median 1, e.g. HumanAim pace = clamp(exp(N(0,0.14)),0.72,1.6)) rather than a symmetric uniform band or a symmetric gaussian — both are tells, real human turn speeds are right-skewed. Layer drifting multi-sine jitter oscillators and per-target randomized gains so no signal is a clean metronome.

patterns.name: Shared control claims
patterns.summary: One ControlClaim{owner,priority,lastRefresh} pattern reused for the rotation, each PacketDelay rule slot, and the hotbar/action lock — any resource two modules might contend for. Token-scoped release means a disabling module can never cancel another's hold.

threat_model.about: A systematic map of the server-side anticheat detectors (not per-module notes). An anticheat only sees your packet stream and runs a fixed set of detectors over it; a technique is safe exactly when none of a server's detectors can separate its packets from a human's. The recurring giveaway is a clean/non-physical value (a perfect KB fraction, an exact face-centre click, a uniform turn speed, a full-strength hit mid-cooldown) that the game's randomness and your network jitter would never produce; the counters put human-plausible noise back, or derive a value the AC itself would accept.

anticheats.Grim: prediction-first, assume this one. Reimplements vanilla physics, replays YOUR inputs each tick, bounds your real position to a tiny offset from predicted (any motion your inputs can't justify flags). Reconstructs the mouse-sensitivity GCD (AimProcessor), checks server-set velocity/KB and explosion precisely, models sprint + use-item slowdown + step height (reads the attribute) + rotation granularity, uses transaction (ping) packets for latency
anticheats.NoCheatPlus: threshold/heuristic, legacy but everywhere. Per-check violation levels (survivalfly speed/air, fastbreak, fastplace, direction, reach, morepackets/timer, autoclicker). No full physics sim, so beaten by being UNDER the number (raw speed, reach distance, CPS). Keepalive for latency
anticheats.Vulcan: heuristic + light prediction; strong motion/aim-pattern and impossible-value checks (speed, phase, aim-GCD, autoclicker regularity)
anticheats.Verus: aggressive statistics on aim and clicks (post-hit rotation, autoclicker variance, packet-order 'badpackets')
anticheats.Intave: strong rotation + movement consistency; sensitive to non-human aim curves and client-only rotations that don't move the body

detector_families.movement_prediction: derives the positions your inputs could produce; a position outside flags (over-speed, step with no attribute, full speed while using an item, a held position-packet drifted too far behind). Grim offset engine; NCP survivalfly as thresholds
detector_families.rotation: (a) GCD: real mice turn in whole sensitivity-derived counts so every legit delta is a grid multiple; a delta off the grid is code-only. (b) smoothness/pattern: uniform yaw-rate, symmetric speed band, or a frozen lock on a moving target is too even. (c) snap/aim-duration/cinematic: an instant large turn, or an inhumanly smooth over-long one, reads non-human
detector_families.timing_cps_order: symmetric/metronomic click gaps, zero press->release variance, constant CPS, or free-running clicks are tells even when the mean CPS is human; packet-order checks catch sequences vanilla never emits
detector_families.reach_hitbox: eye-ray-to-hitbox > ~3 blocks, or a geometrically impossible hit angle, regardless of how the rotation was produced
detector_families.post_combat_order: the rotation/motion right after a hit (Verus), hits before the attack cooldown recharged, an attack packet out of order with its swing/rotation
detector_families.setback_rubberband: reaction to a server position-correction: a client still acting on its pre-setback position, or not accepting the teleport, desyncs further and flags
detector_families.transaction_keepalive_latency: the AC times a round-trip (Grim transactions, NCP keepalive) to know your true latency; this bounds legitimate staleness for movement_prediction AND makes holding one of those packets a direct tell (often a disconnect)

detector_to_counter.flags: motion the replay can't reach; held position drifting past predicted
detector_to_counter.counter: change the inputs/attributes the AC models not the output position (movement_physics); packet-delay allowlist + Max-Desync age cap + flush-on-attack/correction (packet_engine)
snap the WIRE rotation to the grid anchored on last-sent, carry the sub-count remainder (humanization.mouse_gcd, rotation_ownership)

detector_to_counter.flags: uniform yaw-rate, frozen lock, instant snap, over-smooth
detector_to_counter.counter: log-normal per-tick pace + AR(1) drift + rate-limited overshoot + +-70deg/tick flick guard (humanization.eased_rotator)

detector_to_counter.flags: symmetric/metronomic gaps, zero hold-time variance, free-running clicks
detector_to_counter.counter: log-normal gaps + OU CPS walk + repeat-gap + modelled press->release + micro-pauses + Click-Assist amplify-real-only (timing.clicks)
charge gate: hold each click until getAttackStrengthScale >= ~0.9 (timing.clicks)
backtrack aim-ray dot gate + reach check; hitbox expansion projected back to the real box edge (patterns)

detector_to_counter.flags: post-KB motion a clean fraction of the server push
detector_to_counter.counter: velocity precision jitter +-~3%, never a clean fraction (modules.Velocity)

detector_to_counter.flags: no reachable sturdy face; exact face-centre hit-vec; faster than vanilla
detector_to_counter.counter: shared placer sturdy-full-face + reach raytrace; in-plane hit-vec jitter; FastPlace at plausible contexts (placement)

detector_to_counter.flags: more movement packets per second than real time allows
detector_to_counter.counter: never speed the packet clock; delay then release in order, Max-Desync capped (packet_engine)
allowlist those live; never queue them (packet_engine)

detector_to_counter.flags: moving a direction you aren't facing (silent aim, backward sprint, elytra)
detector_to_counter.counter: movement correction re-picks WASD against the server yaw, sprint only when forward (rotation_ownership); elytra sets rotation at tick-end so look == move (prediction_sim)

threat_model.rule_of_thumb: prediction ACs (Grim) are beaten by being physically consistent (change what they model, not the result); heuristic ACs (NCP) are beaten by staying under the threshold. A module safe on one can be instantly fatal on the other (NoSlow is the textbook case), so the per-module anticheat_notes and this map matter more than any single 'legit mode' switch.

modules.name: AimAssist
modules.summary: Smoothly pulls the real camera toward a target, per frame.
modules.technique: Per-frame aim controller: score-picks a target (Distance/Yaw/Armor/Threat/Health, crosshair breaks ties) within Range+Max Angle with line-of-sight, then turns via p.turn(dx/0.15). Simple/Adaptive/Follow-Mouse; full humanization stack (feed-forward lead, overshoot, drift point, shake, reaction + reacquire).
modules.anticheat_notes: Moves the real camera, so it's an aimbot; relies on human-plausible motion (no snaps, GCD-faithful), reaction delay, block-break pauses, item whitelists; yields to SilentAura.

modules.name: SilentAura
modules.summary: Aura that turns only the server-side rotation (camera stays put).
modules.technique: Targets + attack decision at end-of-tick; turning every frame via the shared aim controller feeding either the silent server rotation or the real camera. Trigger (cooldown+aim ready) or CPS click modes; hover = aim ray hits the hitbox in reach with no block between.
modules.hook: end-of-tick decision + per-frame turn + outgoing move-packet (silent rotation)
modules.anticheat_notes: Rotation-ownership claim (OWNER_AURA) so placements/throws don't fight it; GCD-snapped server rotation; movement correction; air-crit sprint drop; shield check; early-hit/miss chances humanize the click stream.

modules.name: AutoClicker
modules.summary: Automated clicking at a target CPS, plus a mace-smash triggerbot.
modules.technique: Per-frame scheduler. Normal (random/drifting CPS), Humanized (click styles + fatigue/bursts + range-aware + misclicks), Click Assist (amplifies each real click), Triggerbot (clicks the crosshair entity when the swing charges; Mace Smash fires only on a qualifying fall-smash, with optional Stun-Slam axe-then-mace). Optional Charge Gate (Normal/Humanized): hold each scheduled click until getAttackStrengthScale(0f) >= a per-click randomized target gateTarget = 0.88 + rand*0.12 (i.e. [0.88,1.0], capped at 1.0), retrying each frame and re-rolling the target after each click — so you never click through the attack cooldown for a 0-knockback reset hit; more damage per swing and the cadence matches the weapon. Triggerbot uses the same idea: one click each time the scale reaches a random point in the Charge range.
modules.anticheat_notes: Lognormal gaps, OU CPS walk, repeat-gap rhythm, injected pauses, modelled press/hold, misclicks; stands down while an aura drives attacks; skips bot entities; Click Assist never free-runs; Charge Gate keeps hits on the cooldown grid.
settings: Mace Smash + Require Fall + Smash Only + Stun Slam

modules.name: Triggerbot
modules.summary: Attacks the entity under the crosshair once the swing is charged.
modules.technique: A mode of AutoClicker: when the crosshair hit result is a valid entity and the attack strength reaches a randomized charge in [Min,Max], fire one click; optional mace-smash gating.
modules.anticheat_notes: Reaction + charge randomization; honours the attack cooldown; skips bots.

modules.name: HitSelect
modules.summary: Holds back attacks that would hurt you more than help.
modules.technique: shouldInterrupt(target) read by the attack path: Pause mode suppresses for a window after each hit; Active holds while target hurtTime>3 (i-frames), optionally while you're rising (wait for the crit/fall) or to let the enemy swing first (KB reduction). Chance rolled once per 250ms window.
modules.anticheat_notes: Only SUPPRESSES swings (no fabricated packets); per-window chance makes it non-deterministic.

modules.name: ShieldBreaker
modules.summary: Swaps to an axe to disable a raised shield before your hit.
modules.technique: 3-phase timer machine: on holding attack at a shielding player, swap to an axe, wait Swap Delay, attack+swing (axe disables the shield), wait Swap Back Delay, optional double-click, swap back to the original slot. Reach-checked via isWithinEntityInteractionRange(target,0.5). The shielded() test gates on isUsingItem() && getUseItem() is SHIELD && getTicksUsingItem() >= 5 — a shield only actually blocks (and can only be disabled) after it's been raised ~5 ticks, so acting earlier wastes the axe swap on a shield that isn't blocking yet and throws away the hit. Also skips AntiBot-flagged targets.
modules.anticheat_notes: Real attack + swing with reach checks; tick-based swap delays, not same-tick teleport swaps; the 5-tick gate avoids a telltale pre-emptive swap.

modules.name: HitSwap
modules.summary: Switches to your best weapon for fights, then back.
modules.technique: Hold mode holds the best weapon (Damage or DPS) while a target is under/near the crosshair; Per Hit mode swaps for just the hit via a pre-attack hook (old item's base damage + new item's effects). Axe On Shield picks an axe vs a blocker.
modules.anticheat_notes: Per-hit swap precedes the attack packet (legit slot-change ordering); yields to auto-mace and manual slot changes.

modules.name: AutoCrit
modules.summary: Times small jumps so your next hit lands while falling (a crit).
modules.technique: Computes cooldown ticks remaining; when it falls within apex+timing of a jump it requests a real jump-key press; drops sprint if airborne with cooldown ready (sprint hits can't crit). Marks CombatState so WTap stands down.
modules.hook: end-of-tick decision + player input tick (jump press)
modules.anticheat_notes: Genuine jump key + real sprint-sync packet (no fabricated crit state); skips liquid/climbable/levitation.

modules.name: WTap
modules.summary: Releases and re-presses forward after a sprint hit for full knockback.
modules.technique: On the attack event, if sprinting + holding W (and not mid-crit), schedule a forward release then re-press; forwardOverride() returns false during the window. Select Hits skips targets in hurt-recovery.
modules.hook: attack event + player input tick (forward override)
modules.anticheat_notes: Overrides a real input key (no packets); defers to AutoCrit; chance/delays keep it non-periodic.

modules.name: JumpReset
modules.summary: Jumps on the tick you take knockback to cancel part of it.
modules.technique: onKnockback: if grounded and it's a real KB push, roll Chance then Accuracy — success presses jump the same tick, a miss schedules it 1-3 ticks late (a mistimed reset).
modules.hook: incoming knockback packet + player input tick (jump press)
modules.anticheat_notes: Real jump press; Accuracy deliberately introduces imperfect/late jumps so it isn't frame-perfect.

modules.name: AntiFireball
modules.summary: Auto-aims and swings to deflect incoming fireballs.
modules.technique: Scans for fireballs moving toward you within angle, leads by velocity*ping-ticks, aims via the shared eased aimer (optionally silent), and only swings once genuinely in entity-interaction range AND aim within 6deg.
modules.anticheat_notes: Requires real melee range before the swing (avoids a reach flag); reaction beat + gaussian swing gaps; releases the rotation claim when idle.

modules.name: AntiBot
modules.summary: Flags fake players (and teammates) so combat/visuals skip them.
modules.technique: Per tick, for each tracked player recompute a behaviour score from independent weak signals summed since first seen: hoverTicks>20 (floated >1s with |vy|<0.003 off-ground, not in water, no vehicle) +10, not in the tab list (getPlayerInfo==null) +4, NPC/red name (name colour == RED, or contains '[NPC]', or starts 'CIT-') +5; bot if score>=threshold (default 8), OR any enabled legacy binary flag (always-invisible / always-stationary (moved < 0.05 from first-seen pos) / never-on-ground / not-in-tab). The verdict is computed ONCE per tick and cached on the per-entity track (t.bot), so isBot() is a cheap cached read for the many callers that ask per frame; an untracked entity (first frame) only answers the history-free tab-list check. Separate teammate test (Ignore Teammates): same vanilla team, OR a shared non-white name TextColor (both non-null, equal, value != 0xFFFFFF), OR a shared non-empty scoreboard PlayerTeam prefix string — how most servers mark teams.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; summed score means no single weak signal false-positives and a still player never trips; teammate detection keeps aura/clicker off your own team.

modules.name: CrystalAura
modules.summary: Places and detonates end crystals for max explosion damage.
modules.technique: Scans obsidian/bedrock near a target for the placement that maxes a real explosion-damage model (distance falloff * ray-grid exposure, armour/blast-prot/Resistance), places and attacks it; interactions carry explicit coords so aiming is purely for legitimacy. Auto/Manual, Rapid-fire, Predict (lead), Auto-obsidian. Min Target Damage threshold (on top of the self-vs-target scoring, anti-suicide/max-self and exposure efficiency): skip any placement or detonation whose estimated damage to the target is <= 0 or below this minimum, so weak trades don't waste crystals.
modules.hook: end-of-tick + outgoing use/attack (silent rotation via useWithSilent)
modules.anticheat_notes: Reachability raytrace per candidate (no placing into walls/on fire); anti-suicide gates every place+detonate; shield-block pause; eased silent/real aim; client-removes the detonated crystal.

modules.name: AutoAnchor
modules.summary: Place/charge/detonate respawn anchors (the explosion combo).
modules.technique: Staged machine PLACE->[COVER]->CHARGE->DETONATE->POST, each step paced by a tick timer, confirmed against the world (anchor present, charge risen) and retried a few ticks. On-Bind runs the whole combo; On-Place watches for your manual placement. Double Anchor + Safe Anchor cover.
modules.anticheat_notes: Reachable-face raytrace (only exposed, in-reach, unobstructed faces); dimension-gated (Nether anchors set spawn); eased silent aim; one-tick slot-sync care. Anti-suicide refuses the detonation if the estimated self-damage would kill you or exceed Max Self Damage: respawn-anchor blast radius 5 (f2 = 2*5), impact = (1 - dist/f2) * exposure where exposure is a line-of-sight check from the blast centre to your eye (clear ClipContext MISS = 1.0, blocked = 0.45, conservative so it errs toward NOT detonating), raw = (impact^2+impact)/2 * 7 * f2 + 1, reduced by the vanilla armour-reduction cut = min(20, max(armor/5, armor - raw/(2+toughness/4)))/25; returns 0 past f2.

modules.name: Velocity
modules.summary: Reduce or cancel server knockback.
modules.technique: onKnockback scales deltaMovement by h=(1-horizontal%) on x/z and v=(1-vertical%) on y after the server applies motion. Precision jitter (optional, default on): before scaling, nudge each of h,v by (rng-0.5)*0.06 clamped to [0,1] — about +-3% per hit — so the result never lands on a clean fraction of the server's push (e.g. exactly 0.40 or a perfect 0), which is a non-physical signature; the jittered result reads like ordinary lag variance.
modules.anticheat_notes: Independent H/V percentages allow partial, legit-looking reduction rather than total immunity; the per-hit jitter scales knockback by raw floats, never clean fractions, so it isn't a detectable constant reduction value.

modules.name: KnockbackDelay
modules.summary: Delays the knockback you take (and packets behind it) briefly.
modules.technique: Incoming PacketDelay rule: on your own motion packet with horizontal>=0.08, with a target near the crosshair, not in liquid, Chance passed, hold it and all following packets until now+delay. Ground vs Air delay.
modules.anticheat_notes: Range-gated to real fights; randomized Chance; capped delay; PacketConflicts avoids clashing with Blink.

modules.name: AutoBlock
modules.summary: Holds your offhand shield up between your own attacks.
modules.technique: Each tick sets keyUse.setDown(true) (drives the vanilla use key, not fake packets) to hold a real block, and releases it (setDown(false)) otherwise. shouldBlock = have a shield (offhand, or main-hand when Main-hand Shields on) AND the mainhand is 'safe' so right-click won't consume it instead (empty, or SWORDS/AXES/MACE/TRIDENT tag) AND (Range<=0 or a non-friend enemy player within Range) AND not attacking (keyAttack down, when Drop On Attack is on). Released on disable, world-leave, or when a screen is open.
modules.anticheat_notes: The block is a real use-key hold that releases cleanly; no fabricated use packets; the safe-mainhand gate stops right-click eating a block/food/bow instead of raising the shield; Drop On Attack lets your swings land.

modules.name: Blink
modules.summary: Freezes outgoing (optionally incoming) packets; release floods them.
modules.technique: Installs FOREVER hold rules on PacketDelay; breadcrumbs where you really walked + a fake box at the server's last-known position. Movement-Only holds just position packets. Auto Send caps the backlog; Flush On Teleport releases on a correction.
modules.anticheat_notes: Never holds keep-alive/config-ack/teleport-accept (those brick the connection); Auto Send threshold + flush-on-teleport bound desync; PacketConflicts arbitrates the slot.

modules.name: BackTrack
modules.summary: Holds a target's position updates after you hit them, for reach.
modules.technique: Per-entity PacketDelay rule holds the target's movement (move/pos-sync/teleport/motion packets, decoded to keep serverPos current) up to Latency; on screen the ghost lingers where it was (closer to you). Arms once, while fighting (hit within 1500ms + eligible target), the first tick their eye-to-hitbox distance grows (moving away) and is still <= 6 blocks. Release (flush) when: you take knockback (hurtTime rose — your own position jumped), the ghost leaves reach (box dist > entityInteractionRange+1) or your ~60deg front cone (look.dot(toGhost) <= 0.5), they stop backing off for >2 ticks, or dist > 6. Aim-ray dot gate (default on): each tick compare how on-crosshair the frozen ghost is (ghostAim = look.dot(normalize(toGhost))) vs where the target really is now (realAim = look.dot(normalize(toReal)) at serverPos); if realAim >= ghostAim the freeze buys nothing, so stop rather than pile on desync — only keep holding while the ghost sits MORE along your look vector than the live position.
modules.anticheat_notes: Eye-ray-to-hitbox + in-front gate so it only holds while the ghost is genuinely hittable; aim-ray dot gate holds only when it actually buys the hit; monotonic-away release; flush on own knockback — minimises flaggable desync.

modules.name: FakeLag
modules.summary: Delays your outgoing position packets.
modules.technique: Outgoing PacketDelay rule. Latency (always), Dynamic (lag while closing a target, dump the backlog at reach so you hit before they react), Repel (lag only while your velocity points at the target). Attack flushes immediately.
modules.anticheat_notes: Allowlist delays only position packets (actions/container/keep-alive live); Max Desync age cap; transmission-offset jitter; flush+pause on attack/hurt/server correction.

modules.name: AutoMace
modules.summary: Mace fall-smash automation (impact-timed hit + mace swap).
modules.technique: Folded into AutoClicker's Mace-Smash triggerbot (fires only on a qualifying airborne fall onto the target: !onGround && !fallFlying && deltaY<0 && fallDistance>1.5, honouring/bypassing the cooldown) plus Auto Item's Auto-Mace section, which swaps the right mace in for the hit via a pre-attack swap. Manual picks the enchant chosen in Mace Type; Auto picks the hotbar mace with the highest EXPECTED SMASH DAMAGE against this target at the current fall distance f: fallBonus = f<=3 ? 4*f : f<=8 ? 12+2*(f-3) : 22+(f-8) (vanilla mace fall curve); raw = 7 (base) + fallBonus + 0.5*densityLvl*f; effective armour = max(0, armorValue*(1 - 0.15*breachLvl)) (Breach cuts effective armour 0.15/level); cut = min(20, max(armor/5, armor - raw/(2 + toughness/4)))/25 (vanilla armour-reduction formula); expected = raw*(1-cut). This weighs Density's raw bonus (scales with the drop) against Breach ignoring armour, so a big fall favours Density even on an armoured target where a fixed threshold would mis-pick.
modules.anticheat_notes: Impact timing from a one-tick fall-sim; genuine attack + pre-attack slot change (~150ms swap-back); Stun-Slam axe-then-mace vs shields.

modules.name: CombatPredictor
modules.summary: Reads what nearby fighters are doing and predicts their next move.
modules.technique: Per-tick tracks each nearby player (closing speed, facing, rising, held item, swing, i-frames), picks the highest threatOf() player, classify()s the current action (Comboing/Pearling/Blocking/Healing/Attacking/Approaching/Retreating/Strafing/Idle), predictNext() from behaviour transitions, computes a relative bearing octant arrow, and optionally pings on a flank.
modules.hook: end-of-tick -> volatile View; HUD render frame
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; purely passive reads of public state; the flank alert plays a local sound only.

modules.name: NoSlow
modules.summary: Removes the movement slowdown from using items.
modules.technique: A movement-input mixin skips just the one use-speed scale in LocalPlayer.modifyInput when isUsingItem() and not riding; sneak and all other modifiers untouched.
modules.anticheat_notes: Surgically skips only the use-item scale, not all speed, so other legitimate slowdowns remain.

modules.name: Step
modules.summary: Walk straight up full blocks without jumping.
modules.technique: Adds a transient STEP_HEIGHT attribute modifier of (Height - base) each tick (the vanilla mount/effect mechanism), removing it off-ground or on disable; never touches the base value.
modules.anticheat_notes: Uses the vanilla transient-attribute path (clean add/remove); Ground Only keeps it from climbing mid-air.

modules.name: Sprint
modules.summary: Hold sprint; keep momentum after a hit.
modules.technique: Forces sprint while moving forward with hunger to spare, re-applying it after an attack would normally break it (coordinated with AutoCrit/Air-Crit so it doesn't spoil a crit).
modules.anticheat_notes: Only drives the vanilla sprint state the player could set themselves.

modules.name: InvWalk
modules.summary: Keep walking/jumping while an inventory screen is open.
modules.technique: From the input mixin while a screen has focus, read the physical movement keybinds, build a fresh Input record and set the normalized move vector.
modules.anticheat_notes: Each of jump/sneak/sprint individually gateable; moving-in-menu is non-vanilla.

modules.name: Parkour
modules.summary: Auto-jumps at the edge of a block when your next step walks off.
modules.technique: Projects your box to next-tick position dropped 0.5 and shrunk by Edge Distance; if noCollision there, request a real jump press.
modules.anticheat_notes: Genuine jump presses; smaller Edge Distance = later, human-looking jumps.

modules.name: Scaffold
modules.summary: Bridging help: auto-sneak at edges, or auto-place under you.
modules.technique: Legit (predictive edge auto-sneak, you place), GodBridge/TellyBridge (place under feet while walking / only airborne). Half-block-aware placeY, nearest-first feet-spot ring, Expand re-anchor to the 8 neighbour columns, Tower pillaring; silent-aimed place rotation.
modules.hook: end-of-tick + input tick (sneak override) + outgoing use
modules.anticheat_notes: Shared placer only clicks sturdy reachable faces (no rejected place packet); Legit edge-sneak on a randomized human hold; yields the rotation to Clutch; eased GCD-snapped aim.

modules.name: Surround
modules.summary: Walls the blocks around your feet against crystals/anchors.
modules.technique: Only runs with a placeable BlockItem in the main hand (and, when Keep Centered is on, while you stand roughly mid-block: frac(x) and frac(z) both in 0.30..0.70). Builds the target set — the 4 horizontal neighbours of your feet, plus the block below when Floor is on — and places through the shared PlacementSearch planner: frontier(targets) gives the subset placeable this tick cheapest-aim-movement first, and it places up to Blocks/Tick of them, calling BlockPlacer.placeAt and, when Silent Aim is on, claiming the server rotation (OWNER_PLACE, correctMovement=false) toward the reported hit point. The frontier re-expands next tick as placed blocks create new supports.
modules.anticheat_notes: Shared placer only clicks sturdy reachable faces (no rejected place packet); aim claimed as a low-priority placement owner so combat/clutch win contention; eased GCD-snapped silent aim.

modules.name: Clutch
modules.summary: Places blocks to save a fatal/void/long fall.
modules.technique: Fall-sim trigger (void/lethal/>Blocks, catching knockback arcs) + nearest-first downward scan of the 3x3 ring plus the momentum/landing column; places at the highest reachable support, restores slot+view. Catches you stepping off an edge, descending, or staircasing.
modules.hook: end-of-tick + outgoing use + per-frame real-view ease
modules.anticheat_notes: Block placed off the hit result (not the rotation) so a slow/eased look never misses; released() guard stops the view/silent rotation sticking mid-air; highest rotation priority (OWNER_CLUTCH).

modules.name: AutoBucket/MLG
modules.summary: Water-clutch a fall, pick the bucket back up.
modules.technique: A section of Auto Item: on a fall past (optionally lethal) threshold, look down ~82deg, place water on the first sturdy reachable block below, pick it back up on landing.
modules.anticheat_notes: Places water only on a genuinely reachable sturdy face (no out-of-reach place packet).

modules.name: AutoPearl
modules.summary: Throws a pearl to where an enemy's pearl will land.
modules.technique: Simulate the enemy pearl's full arc (vanilla throwable physics) to its landing, brute-force the launch pitch whose own pearl lands nearest, throw it silent-aimed once the aim is on line; only if the best miss is within Tolerance.
modules.anticheat_notes: Eased silent aim; swap-in/use/swap-back sequence; rotation claim released on finish.

modules.name: PearlCatch
modules.summary: Throws a pearl then a wind charge to catch and redirect it.
modules.technique: On a keybind: aim+throw a pearl (straight up or at current aim), wait Charge Delay, aim at the pearl in flight (predictively led) and fire a wind charge to redirect it; restores slot and switches off.
modules.anticheat_notes: Feeds the silent rotation into the use path so the throws actually go where aimed; eased aim.

modules.name: WindCharge
modules.summary: Wind-charge jump on a keybind for max height.
modules.technique: Aims straight down at your feet, jumps, and pops a wind charge at the ground as you leave it so the blast stacks on the jump; restores slot and switches off.
modules.hook: end-of-tick phase machine + input tick (jump) + outgoing use (useWithSilent)
modules.anticheat_notes: Genuine jump + use; feeds the silent down-rotation into the use packet so the charge fires at your feet not the camera.

modules.name: BedBreaker
modules.summary: Fastest-tool break of a bed's cover blocks.
modules.technique: Derive both bed halves from facing, build first-layer cover positions, simulate every hotbar tool's destroy progress against every cover block to pick the fastest (cover, tool) pair, phased break.
modules.anticheat_notes: Real break packets at a vanilla rate; reach-checked.

modules.name: AutoFarm
modules.summary: Harvests ripe crops and replants, one action per delay.
modules.technique: Stationary mode scans a radius box for ripe crops (CropBlock.isMaxAge / nether wart age) or empty farmland, breaks with startDestroyBlock+swing, replants the mapped seed against the soil top face with a temporary slot switch. Walk mode defers to the pathfinder's farm process.
modules.anticheat_notes: Genuine break/use + swing with a configurable per-action delay (not packet spoofing); 1-5 block range; Walk leans on the bot's human layer.

modules.name: AutoMine
modules.summary: Mines chosen block types via the pathfinding bot.
modules.technique: Resolves block IDs and drives the pathfinder's mine process; Legit Mine restricts to ores it can actually see (branch-mines between them). Self-disables when full or the quantity is reached.
modules.anticheat_notes: Relies on the bot's real movement/mining + human-look layer; Legit avoids the X-ray tell of pathing straight to hidden ore.

modules.name: BaseFinder
modules.summary: Scores chunks for stashes by storage/valuable/amethyst weight, with auto-explore.
modules.technique: Weighted per-chunk activity score over block entities (shulker 100 flag-alone, spawner 20, hopper 4, double-chest 3 counted once, etc.) plus an optional valuable-block/amethyst pass (the anti-ESP bypass for servers that hide chest data); flags over a threshold. RTP/Walk/Fly auto-drive (the last via a self-contained elytra autopilot) and toast/sound/webhook alerts.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side detection (reads already-received block data; amethyst concentration bypass needs no X-ray packets); auto-drive legitimacy comes from the bot/elytra human layers; RTP sends normal chat commands.

modules.name: BlockSearch
modules.summary: X-ray-style through-wall outlines of chosen blocks.
modules.technique: Maintains a per-chunk find map, scanning a nearest-first round-robin of chunks per tick, skipping air-only sections and palettes that can't contain a wanted block; renders distance-sorted 12-edge projected boxes capped at Max Shown.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (reads received chunk data; no packets).

modules.name: AutoFish
modules.summary: Auto-fishes with multi-signal bite detection and recast.
modules.technique: CAST->WAIT_HOOK->FISHING machine; a bite is confirmed when N of four independent signals agree within 500ms (synced hook state, splash sound, particle burst, sharp bobber dip). Randomized reel/recast delays; rod-swap and anti-break.
modules.anticheat_notes: Signal fusion avoids false reels; randomized delays; stops before the rod breaks.

modules.name: AutoItem
modules.summary: Consolidated item automation: Tool/Weapon/Totem/Heal/Bucket/Armor/Shield/Mace.
modules.technique: Each behaviour is a toggleable section. Swaps best tool/weapon while attacking; moves totem/shield/armor through the always-open player menu (no screen) or one-key-per-tick; Auto Heal plans hotbar heals; Auto Bucket does MLG; Auto Mace picks Density/Breach and hands the slot to the pre-attack swap. A shared randomized delay throttles everything.
modules.anticheat_notes: Reach checks, never acting through an open screen, one-key-per-tick ordering, shared gaussian timing, danger-gated totem/heal, water only on a reachable sturdy face.
settings: per-section toggles + sub-settings (Totem Open/Silent, Heal Health/Type, Bucket Fall, Armor Keep Elytra, Mace selection)

modules.name: InventoryTweaks
modules.summary: Container QoL: sort, move-all, scroll-transfer, refill, slot locks, auto steal/deposit.
modules.technique: All actions are real slot clicks paced a few per tick through a queue; sorting simulates on a copy to emit a minimal click sequence; auto steal/deposit QUICK_MOVE one eligible slot per Move Delay with whitelist/blacklist; persistent slot locks honoured everywhere.
modules.anticheat_notes: Real slot-click packets at a throttled rate; randomized move delay.

modules.name: ChestStealer
modules.summary: Auto-loot a container; best-only mode.
modules.technique: A mode of Inventory Tweaks' auto-steal: QUICK_MOVE eligible slots one per delay, optionally only items better than what's equipped (via the shared item score), closing when done.
modules.anticheat_notes: Throttled real clicks; mouse-travel pacing.

modules.name: AutoArmor
modules.summary: Equip best armour per slot + a 2-set quick-swap.
modules.technique: A section of Auto Item: rank candidates with the shared item score and equip the best per slot through the open player menu (no screen), with a combat guard and paced clicks.
modules.anticheat_notes: Own-menu swaps, no screen; paced/randomized clicks.

modules.name: AutoHeal/ThrowPot
modules.summary: Heal from the hotbar / throw pots overheal-aware.
modules.technique: A section of Auto Item: builds a plan of hotbar healing items to cover missing HP (Instant Health pots / soup), throwing splash pots by pitching to 90deg; amplifier-aware.
modules.anticheat_notes: Danger/deficit gated; paced.

modules.name: FastPlace
modules.summary: Shortens the right-click cooldown for chosen items.
modules.technique: At end-of-tick, clamp the vanilla right-click delay field down to Delay+1 for selected item categories; blocks can be gated to bridging contexts only.
modules.anticheat_notes: Leaves non-selected items at vanilla speed; the bridging gate limits rapid-place to plausible contexts.

modules.name: AntiAfk
modules.summary: Small random actions so the server doesn't idle-kick you.
modules.technique: On a randomized interval, pick jump/look/swing/strafe; key actions injected as simulated presses for a few ticks. Only-When-Idle gates on no real movement.
modules.anticheat_notes: Small randomized actions; suppressed while most screens are open.

modules.name: AutoGg
modules.summary: Sends gg when a minigame ends.
modules.technique: Matches incoming chat against a regex of end phrases, schedules a chat send after a delay (30s cooldown); cancels on world leave.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; cooldown prevents spam.

modules.name: AutoRespawn
modules.summary: Presses Respawn on the death screen after a delay.
modules.technique: On the death screen, after Delay call player.respawn() (the same call the button makes).
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: AutoReconnect
modules.summary: Rejoins the last server after a disconnect.
modules.technique: Off its own tick subscription; on the disconnect screen, after Delay start connecting to the remembered server; give up after Max Attempts; a world >15s resets the count.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Indicators
modules.summary: Arrows around the crosshair toward incoming projectiles.
modules.technique: Each frame, filter moving projectiles within Distance; Threat/Hit-Only modes simulate up to 60 ticks of flight and test whether the path enters your hitbox / nears your movement path; draw a bearing arrow scaled by proximity.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Freelook
modules.summary: Hold a key to swing the 3rd-person camera without turning your body.
modules.technique: On hold, switch to third-person-back and consume mouse deltas into local yaw/pitch fields the camera reads, leaving the player's rotation untouched; restore on release.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Freecam
modules.summary: Detaches the camera to fly it while the player stays still.
modules.technique: Holds its own transform; a camera hook flies it with WASD/space/shift using frame-rate-independent velocity smoothing; the player never moves.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (player never moves).

modules.name: Trajectory
modules.summary: Draws the predicted path/landing of the held projectile.
modules.technique: Builds the initial shot exactly as each item spawns its projectile (per-item speed/gravity, inherited shooter motion), steps up to 400 ticks reproducing per-kind physics order, ray-clips blocks and entities, renders a camera-facing smoothed ribbon + landing marker.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (prediction + render; no packets); only the mean arc is drawn, not the random spread.

modules.name: Tracers
modules.summary: Lines from the crosshair to nearby entities.
modules.technique: Project each wanted entity; draw a line from screen centre to on-screen targets, or out toward the screen edge along the computed bearing for off-screen ones. Color by Distance/Fixed/Type.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: OffscreenArrows
modules.summary: Arrows around the crosshair pointing at off-screen entities.
modules.technique: Project each target; skip on-screen ones; for off-screen/behind compute the bearing and place a filled triangle at a radius from centre, colored by distance.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Waypoints
modules.summary: Named dimension-scoped world markers with distance labels.
modules.technique: Persisted waypoint list; projects each (clamped to the screen edge when off-screen) as a labeled card with distance and an accent/beam; add-here keybind, death waypoint, a manager screen.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (local markers).

modules.name: StaffDetector
modules.summary: Watches the tab list for staff ranks / watch-listed names.
modules.technique: Each tick scan listed players; match rank keywords in team prefix/suffix/display name and a watch-name list; dedupe by UUID; alert (toast/sound) and optionally auto-leave.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (reads tab-list data); the only outbound action is a normal disconnect.

modules.name: Bot
modules.summary: Pathfinding-bot config + the human-behaviour layer.
modules.technique: Settings-only config for the pathfinder bridge; drives a per-frame spring-eased human look (noise/overshoot/reaction/wander), random pauses, sprint variance and walking glances layered over the pathfinder so it reads human.
modules.anticheat_notes: The humanization control surface: the view really turns (no freelook spoof), eased with noise/overshoot, movement matches the path, anticheat-compat on.

modules.name: ElytraPilot
modules.summary: Self-contained elytra autopilot (no pathfinder).
modules.technique: Once per tick: deploy via a jump-press edge, steer yaw toward a far X/Z target (+wander+jitter), control pitch to a terrain-aware cruise altitude via a heightmap-corridor lookahead (hard pull-up at a cliff face), boost on a randomized cadence; eased, GCD-snapped rotation.
modules.anticheat_notes: Sets rotation at tick-end so the next physics step AND move packet share one rotation (you always move toward look — the classic elytra flag avoided); boosts randomized; only genuine inputs.
settings: (driven by BaseFinder Fly settings: Altitude, Height Variation, Humanization)

modules.name: ESP
modules.summary: Through-wall boxes/skeleton/outline + chams for entities, with a true-3D World mode.
modules.technique: Per frame, lerp each entity and project its 8 AABB corners (or skeleton joints) to screen space; draw 2D lines/rects (2D/3D/Skeleton). World mode instead builds camera-relative box geometry (WorldMesh) and submits it inside the level render pass (on the LEVEL_SUBMIT event) via submitCustomGeometry, so edges depth-test and occlude against terrain with no behind-camera flicker: ribbon-quad lines with depth-independent width + 1px feather, near-plane-clipped edges, optional ~14%-alpha filled faces and a faded through-wall pass. Outline mode uses the vanilla glow framebuffer; chams draw targets through walls in skin/flat colours in the entity pass. The 2D box was fixed to shrink to the in-front corners instead of vanishing when a corner crosses behind the camera.
modules.hook: world overlay + level-submit (World mode geometry) + entity-render mixins (glow/chams)
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; through-wall visibility is an info advantage but modifies no gameplay; World-mode submit is wrapped in try/catch that disables the module on error so a render exception can't crash the frame.

modules.name: StorageEsp
modules.summary: Outlines storage block-entities, optionally through walls.
modules.technique: Walk loaded chunks around you, classify block entities by type for colour, range + (unless through-walls) line-of-sight check, project the AABB to Box or flattened Frame; distinct outline for open containers.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; through-walls reveals hidden containers (ESP-class) but changes no state.

modules.name: NameTags
modules.summary: Client-styled through-wall name tags with gear/health/strength readout.
modules.technique: Screen-space tags over living entities (pooled, nearest-first, far-to-near draw); shows name/health/distance/effects and a gear row with enchant labels; a hits-to-kill damage model drives a strength-vs-you indicator; suppresses the vanilla tag for covered entities.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; gear/health readout is an info advantage, no gameplay change.

modules.name: Radar
modules.summary: Top-down radar of nearby entities, colored by intent.
modules.technique: 2D radar rotates each target's X/Z offset by view yaw, scales to pixels, clamps/hides past the edge; Intent colouring classifies aiming (look dot direction-to-you over cos(aimAngle)) vs approaching (velocity dot) vs neutral. Text mode lists nearest.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (passive radar).

modules.name: Zoom
modules.summary: Hold-to-zoom with scroll-to-adjust.
modules.technique: Hold key; the FOV hook divides camera FOV by the smoothed zoom level; scroll adjusts it multiplicatively; optional smooth-camera.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (FOV only); standard allowed-everywhere zoom.

modules.name: Fullbright
modules.summary: Max brightness via a client-only Night Vision effect.
modules.technique: Applies an infinite hidden Night Vision effect to the client player; never sent to the server.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (effect applied locally, not transmitted).

modules.name: FovChanger
modules.summary: Custom FOV, optionally static (no sprint/bow FOV change).
modules.technique: Snapshots and sets the vanilla fov and fovEffectScale options (0 = static); restores on disable.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (vanilla options).

modules.name: Crosshair
modules.summary: Configurable crosshair with cooldown, hit markers, miss ticks.
modules.technique: Draws cross/dot/circle from rounded rects; dynamic gap/colour from attack-strength (Smooth interpolated); cooldown ring arc; miss ticks recorded when a swing registers no attack.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (reads swing state).

modules.name: TimeChanger
modules.summary: Client-side time-of-day override.
modules.technique: Maps presets to day-time ticks; the clock mixin substitutes the rendered world time; server time unchanged.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: WeatherChanger
modules.summary: Forces clear/rain/thunder on your screen.
modules.technique: Each tick pins the client level's rain/thunder levels; server weather unaffected.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Chat
modules.summary: Chat QoL: timestamps, heads, copy, history, slide-in, search, translate.
modules.technique: Hooks the chat pipeline to prepend heads/timestamps, slide-animate new lines, hide join/leave, copy-on-click, and translate via an async external service.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; translation sends text to an external service (a privacy/network side effect, not gameplay).

modules.name: VisualTweaks
modules.summary: A family of small render tweaks (one module per group).
modules.technique: A stateless facade the render mixins call, delegating to per-group modules: LowFire, ClearWater, NoHurtCam, HitColor, ItemGlint, OldAnimations, Hand, ShieldTotem, HideOverlays, NoViewBobbing, ItemPhysics, BlockOutline, InventoryBlur. Most are state-only flags read by mixins or vanilla-option writes; a couple rewrite GPU textures (hit colour, glint tint).
modules.hook: various render mixins + vanilla options + texture replacement
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side; the old-animations block-hit swing is explicitly local (no attack packet).
settings: (per-group: fire offset/opacity, clear-water fog/overlay, tilt strength, hurt colour, glint mode/tint, swing scale, hand size/offset/bob, shield/totem offset, hidden HUD elements, item physics)

modules.name: Watermark
modules.summary: Client branding badge (Chips/Pill/Bar/Wordmark).
modules.technique: Typography/layout of logo + name/version + optional user/server/clock/fps, pixel-snapped to an optical baseline.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Keystrokes
modules.summary: On-screen WASD/mouse keys lighting up on press.
modules.technique: Reads vanilla keybind down-states + input-tracker mouse/CPS; each key Smooth-lerps idle->pressed colour; Glass/Solid/Outline styles.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: EnabledModules
modules.summary: Array-list of enabled modules (Text GUI).
modules.technique: Filters enabled toggleable modules, builds labels, sorts by width/alpha, fades rows via per-module Smooth, gradient/chroma text, a connected stepped backdrop snapped to physical pixels.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: NearbyPlayers
modules.summary: Mini health/armor bars for nearby players (HUD + above-head).
modules.technique: Collects players by TargetSetting, sorted by distance; HUD rows show name/health/armor/distance/gear; overlay floats a bar above each head via the projector.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (passive info overlay).

modules.name: TargetHud
modules.summary: Health/stat/comparison panel for the entity you fight.
modules.technique: Target = hovered or the combat-tracker target; Smooth-animated HP + fade; comparison chips (damage per swing, pots, combo, hits) and a win indicator.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: PotionHud
modules.summary: Active effects with timers (Panel/List/Rings).
modules.technique: Reads active effects, sorts by remaining duration; Rings mode tracks longest-seen duration per effect for a progress arc; can hide the vanilla top-right icons.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: ArmorHud
modules.summary: Worn armour (+held) with per-piece durability.
modules.technique: Reads the four armour slots + hands, computes durability fractions, draws Panel (rows) or Compact (strip) with vanilla decorations suppressed.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: InventoryHud
modules.summary: Draws the 3x9 main inventory on screen.
modules.technique: Reads the 27 main slots and draws each item; optional slot backgrounds; hide-when-empty.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Compass
modules.summary: Sliding heading strip with cardinals, ticks, waypoint bearings.
modules.technique: Heading from player yaw; projects headings onto the strip, draws cardinal labels + ticks scissored to it; plots waypoint bearings as dots.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Rearview
modules.summary: Rearview-mirror panel rendering the world looking backward.
modules.technique: An off-screen render target; a renderer hook runs an extra throttled pass with the view flipped backward; the panel draws the target flipped vertically (and optionally horizontally).
modules.hook: renderer mixin (extra pass) + HUD render frame
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: NowPlaying
modules.summary: Now-playing media with art, progress, and media keys.
modules.technique: Polls an OS media controller for the current track + album art; keybinds send play/next/previous (OS automation).
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (OS integration, nothing game-facing).

modules.name: Scoreboard
modules.summary: Restyled sidebar scoreboard in the client font.
modules.technique: Builds sidebar lines like vanilla; Auto font mode falls back to the pixel font when the client font can't render a glyph (so server space-glyph layouts line up).
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: StaffList
modules.summary: Online staff read from the tab list with time online.
modules.technique: Scans listed players, extracts a rank word from team prefix/suffix/display name via keyword match, tracks first-seen for time online; renders with optional head icons.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side (public tab data).

modules.name: KeybindList
modules.summary: Panel of modules with a keybind.
modules.technique: Lists bound modules (optionally only enabled) with category icon + key; HOLD tag; dim disabled.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: AttackTimer
modules.summary: Attack-cooldown bar + swing-timing meter.
modules.technique: Cooldown from attack-strength scale; a swing watcher records the gap between swings and colours it good/early/amber vs the ideal delay.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Cps
modules.summary: Mouse clicks per second.
modules.technique: Reads left/right/max CPS from the input tracker.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Speed
modules.summary: Horizontal movement speed.
modules.technique: Instantaneous speed from position delta, exponentially smoothed; unit-converted.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Coordinates
modules.summary: Player X/Y/Z with optional Nether conversion.
modules.technique: Reads player position; Nether coords multiply X/Z by 8 or 0.125 by dimension.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: TextHudReadouts
modules.summary: Single-line Label:value readouts sharing a Layout setting.
modules.technique: A TextHud base: Fps, Ping, Tps, Memory, Health, Direction, Biome, DayCounter, ServerAddress, SessionTimer, ReachDisplay, ComboCounter, ItemCounter, ToggleSprint — each reads one piece of game state (fps, latency, estimated TPS from time-sync packet intervals, JVM RAM, health, facing, biome, in-game day, server ip, uptime, last-hit reach, combo, item count, sprint state).
modules.hook: HUD render frame (+ some end-of-tick sampling)
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Clock
modules.summary: Real-world clock, digital or analog.
modules.technique: Reads system time; analog mode draws a face with trig-computed hands.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Performance
modules.summary: One-click FPS presets tuning vanilla options + perf modules.
modules.technique: Action-driven presets (Balanced/Max FPS/Vanilla Defaults) write vanilla video options and configure the perf modules; also sets chunk-builder threads in the renderer mod's config.
modules.hook: action callbacks (options + other-module settings + file write)
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance; side effects are file writes + a sysctl probe (host, not network).

modules.name: AdaptiveQuality
modules.summary: Drops effects while FPS is low, restores on recovery.
modules.technique: Hysteresis on getFps(): lower vignette/fog/clouds/particles (and optionally render/sim distance) after FPS stays under a threshold, restore above threshold+15.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: EntityCulling
modules.summary: Skips entities fully hidden behind solid blocks.
modules.technique: Up to 9 camera->entity rays; all-blocked = culled; results cached ~150ms per entity; skips self/near/players(opt)/chams targets.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: EntityDistance
modules.summary: Vanilla entity-distance scaling + per-type render cutoffs.
modules.technique: Drives the vanilla entityDistanceScaling option and a per-type squared-distance cutoff from the camera.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: ParticleLimiter
modules.summary: Drops/caps particles and skips unseen ones.
modules.technique: shouldSkip at spawn: optional behind-camera / behind-wall view cull, a per-second cap, and a keep-percentage random drop.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: BlockEntityCull
modules.summary: Stops rendering block entities past a distance.
modules.technique: cull(blockEntity): squared camera distance > limit = skip.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: DroppedItem
modules.summary: Caps how many dropped items render per frame.
modules.technique: Per-frame counter; beyond Max Rendered, skip further item entities that frame.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: NoEntityShadows
modules.summary: Turns off entity blob shadows.
modules.technique: A flag the shadow render mixin reads to skip the shadow pass.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: FastRender
modules.summary: Bundled vanilla render tweaks for FPS.
modules.technique: Snapshots and sets vanilla options: freeze glint, biome-blend 0, weather radius, simplified clouds.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side performance.

modules.name: BugFixes
modules.summary: Small client-side vanilla gameplay fixes.
modules.technique: No Click Delay zeroes the post-miss attack lockout; No Jump Delay clears the head-bump jump cooldown; Keep Sprint On Hit re-sets sprint when the key is held.
modules.anticheat_notes: Client-side micro-tweaks; No Click Delay / Keep Sprint touch combat timing/sprint (minor) — borderline but not aim/packet cheating.

modules.name: Panic
modules.summary: One-press kill switch disabling every module.
modules.technique: An action that disables all enabled toggleable modules (muted); Re-enable restores exactly those next press; the lite build uninjects the whole client.
modules.anticheat_notes: client-side safety feature.

modules.name: ClientSettings
modules.summary: Global client config hub (menu key, notifications, sounds, name-protect, recording, update notifier).
modules.technique: Settings-only; exposes static accessors read across the client (protect-name text swap, recording hides HUD/world, update-notify flag).
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side config; Name Protect/Recording hide visuals for streaming/capture.

modules.name: Style
modules.summary: Global look-and-feel source for HUD + click GUI.
modules.technique: Settings-only; fonts/corners/backgrounds/colors read by all render code; applies fonts and blur params.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: Macro
modules.summary: Command/item/keybind macros.
modules.technique: A trigger (key) runs an action list (chat command, item use, module toggle).
modules.anticheat_notes: Depends on the action; chat/toggle are client-side.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.summary: In-client toast queue + history.
modules.technique: A shared ring buffer of events rendered as sliding toasts; module toggles, alerts and update notices post here.
modules.anticheat_notes: cosmetic/client-side.

modules.name: HitFlick
modules.summary: Flicks your yaw off and back onto a target at the hit to steer the knockback they take.
modules.technique: A sprint-hit's bonus knockback is applied in the attacker's facing direction, so briefly turning the server-side yaw a few degrees off-target at the hit sends the victim off at that angle (Left/Right/Alternate). Pitch stays on-target so reach/raytrace stays valid. Silent via the rotation-claim (priority just above the aura). Hooked from the attack call.
modules.anticheat_notes: Inherently flag-prone: a large or every-hit flick fails a strict 'looking at target' check. Defend it like anti-knockback — a Chance gate (flick only some hits), a small angle, a 1-tick window, and ideally a Blink packet-choke (hold movement+attack during the flick, flush together right after) so the server sees one on-target->flick->on-target sequence, not a sustained off-target look.
modules.settings: Flick Angle, Direction (Left/Right/Alternate), Chance, Silent, Window, Only Sprinting, With Aura, Blink (choke)

modules.name: Cheat Detector
modules.summary: Analysis, not a cheat: scores OTHER players by how likely they're cheating, from the data a client legitimately receives.
modules.technique: Per-player rolling score from their position stream + head rotation, using the signals the server ACs use: sustained over-vanilla horizontal speed, airborne with ~zero vertical velocity (no gravity), inhuman instant head-turns, near-zero turn-speed variance (robotic). Scores decay so a flag means a sustained pattern; conservative thresholds for accuracy.
modules.anticheat_notes: Detection-only, never touches anyone's game — the inverse of the bypass work. Can't observe their attacks directly (no reach check client-side), only movement + rotation.
modules.settings: Range, Speed/Flight/Aim-Snap toggles, Confidence threshold, Toast On Flag, On-screen Marker

modules.name: Network Adaptation
modules.summary: Measures your real ping/jitter and auto-tunes timing-sensitive modules so they stay inside the server's lag-comp window and back off on a spike.
modules.technique: A shared network-conditions monitor (smoothed ping EMA + jitter + a spike flag, from the keep-alive/transaction RTT) exposes a hold budget = lag-comp-window(~150-200ms) - ping - jitter. Packet-delay modules (KnockbackDelay/BackTrack/FakeLag) cap their hold to it and pause on a spike; the aura/clicker skip combat hits during a spike. Lives in a global Humanization hub with a master realism dial.
modules.anticheat_notes: MEASURES latency, never fakes it — a spoofed ping/timer is itself what the timer check catches, so faking is self-defeating. Cannot beat a constantly-high ping (that ceiling is physics); it kills the EXTRA flags from spikes and from modules overstepping the window.
modules.settings: Humanization Level (master), Network Adaptation, Network Toasts

modules.name: Self-Flag
modules.summary: Client-side 'would this flag?' warning: watches the packets you send and warns in chat the moment two actions land in one tick.
modules.technique: Counts real action packets (attack/interact, use/place, block-action — not movement/swing/keepalive) per tick on the outgoing path; a vanilla client sends at most one per tick, so >1 is a signature. Warns in chat (throttled) with the action kinds so you fix the setting (a 0ms delay, an over-fast clicker, two modules sharing a slot) before an anticheat sees it.
modules.anticheat_notes: Read-only, changes nothing. Encodes the core anti-ban rule: one action per tick, in the order the server expects.
